notes.title: Fantasmigon’s Early Access Debut: Form Your Gang and Battle Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! We’re thrilled to introduce the very first early-access build of Fantasmigon on Steam. In this build, you’ll get a hands-on experience with our core mechanics: forming a diverse gang of characters and engaging in strategic, turn-based multiplayer skirmishes.

Currently, you can choose between two formidable gangs—Dwarves and Goblins—each featuring three unique characters packed with distinctive abilities. During your turn, select a character, use the mouse to navigate the action wheel, and carefully plan your moves. You can rotate the wheel by scrolling the mouse wheel or pressing the Q and E keys. Once you commit to ‘Turn End,’ all prepared abilities and actions will activate simultaneously, so positioning and timing are everything.

We’re just getting started. In the near future, we plan to introduce a brand-new gang, expand existing rosters, and add a single-player mode complete with AI-driven opponents. It’s an exciting journey ahead, and we’re grateful to have you here from the very beginning.

Have fun, and we look forward to your feedback!
